spans.s:
शौरसेनी N. of a Prākṛta
dialect.

1 N. of Viṣṇu or
Kṛṣṇa.
--2 Of Balarāma.
--3 The
planet Saturn.

सौरिः [सूरस्यापत्यं पुमान् इञ्]
1 N.
of the planet Saturn.
--2 The Asana
tree.
--3 N. of Yama.
--4 Of Karṇa.
--5 Of Sugrīva.
--Comp.
--रत्नं a
kind of gem (sapphire).

शौर्प a. (र्पी f.) Measured by
or belonging to a शूर्प or
winnowingbasket.

शौर्यं [शूरस्य भावः ष्यञ्]
1
Prowess, heroism, valour; शौर्ये वैरिणि
वज्रमाशु निपतत्वर्थोऽस्तु नः केवलं

; नये च शौर्ये च वसंति संपदः
Subhāṣ.
--2 Strength, power, might.
--3 Representation of war and
supernatural events on the stage; cf.
आरभटी.

सौर a. (री f.) [सूरस्य इदं मूरो
देवतास्य वा अण्]
1 Relating to the sun,
solar.
--2 Sacred or dedicated to the
sun.
--3 Worshipping the sun.
--4 Celestial, divine.
--5 Relating to
spirituous liquor.
--रः
1 A
worshipper of the sun.
--2 The planet
Saturn.
--3 A solar month.
--4 A
solar day.
--5 The plant called
Tumburu.
--6 N. of Yama, the
god of death.
--रं N. of a
collection of hymns (extracted from
the Ṛgveda) addressed to Sūrya.
--Comp.
--नक्तं a particular
religious observance.
--मासः a solar
month (comprising thirty risings
and settings of the sun).
--लोकः
the sun's sphere.
सौरथः A hero, warrior.

सौरभ a. (भी f.) [सुरभिरस्यास्ति
[]
अण्] Fragrant.
--भं
1 Fragrance,

.
--2 Saffron.

सौरभेय a. (यी f.) Relating to
Surabhi.
--यः An ox.

सौरभी, सौरभेयी
1 A cow.
--2 N.
of the daughter of the cow called
Surabhi; तां सौरभेयीं सुरभिर्यशोभिः

सौरभी, सौरभेयी
1 A cow.
--2 N.
of the daughter of the cow called
Surabhi; तां सौरभेयीं सुरभिर्यशोभिः

1 Fragrance, odour, sweet
scent; सौरभ्यं भुवनत्रयेऽपि विदितं
; पुनाना सौरभ्यैः G.

.
--2 Agreeableness, beauty.
--3 Good character, reputation, glory,
fame.

सौरसेनाः m. pl. N. of a district
and its people.
--नी See शौरसेनी.
सौरसेयः An epithet of Skanda.

सौरसैंधव a. (वी f.) Belonging
to the celestial river or Ganges,
Gangetic; Śi. 13. 27.
--वः A horse
of the sun.
सौरस्यं Tastiness, savoriness.

सौराज्यं Good government or
rule; एको ययौ चैत्ररथप्रदेशान्
सौराज्यरम्यानपरो विदर्भान्

सौराष्ट्र a. (ष्ट्रा or ष्ट्री f.) Coming
from or relating to the district
called Surāṣṭra (or Surat).
--ष्ट्रः The
district of Surāṣṭra. --m. pl. The
people of Surāṣṭra.
--ष्ट्रं Brass,
bellmetal.

सौराष्ट्र (also called आनर्त) The modern peninsula of
Kattywar. Dvārakā is called आनर्तनगरी or अब्धिनगरी.
The old Dvārakā stood near Madhupura 95 miles
south-east of Dvārakā, and also near mount
Raivataka, which appears to be the same as the Girinar
hill near Junagad. Valabhi appears to have been
the next capital of the country, the ruins of which
were discovered at Bilbi 10 miles north-west of
Bhownaggar. The celebrated lake Prabhāsa was
situated in the same country and stood on the
sea-coast.
सौराष्ट्रकः A kind of bell-metal.

सौरिक a. (की f.)
1 Celestial.
--2
Spirituous, vinous.
--3 Due for
spirits (such as duty or money.)
--कः
1
Saturn.
--2 Heaven, paradise.
--3
A vender of spirituous liquor.
सौरी The wife of the sun.

सौरीय a. (यी f.)
1 Solar.
--2 Fit
for, or suitable to, the sun.

सौर्य a. (र्यी f.) Belonging to the
sun, solar.
